products.name: Voiceflow
products.note: Conversational AI design; voice/chat agent builder; enterprise team features

profile_text.body:
Voiceflow is a software company that describes itself as an AI agent platform for customer experience automation. Its platform is designed to let teams build, launch, and scale chat and voice AI agents for customer support and customer experience applications. The company positions its tooling toward enterprise users, emphasizing capabilities for conversational design, voice and chat agent construction, and team collaboration at scale.

Voiceflow's core product, tracked under the coding and developer tools category, centers on conversational AI design and agent building for both voice and chat channels. A user quoted on the company's site, Andre Fredericks, describes the platform as providing acceleration for experimentation and enabling teams to focus on orchestration and building generative conversational architecture. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations appear in the available facts.
